description: Land Title Settlement Department - Batugedara, Ratnapura D/S Division, Ratnapura  District   - Cad. Map No.  620291
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to specific land parcels (No. 57 and 58) with detailed ownership information, property boundaries, and legal status. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and deals specifically with land registration matters, making it a clear example of Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
